description: GeoCLUSTER is a Python and Dash application published by Pacific Northwest National Laboratory for exploring closed-loop geothermal designs. It interpolates a precomputed thermal-hydraulic simulation database or runs a slender-body-theory simulator, then combines subsurface outputs with plant and economic calculations. Users vary well depth, geology, flow, working fluid and power-cycle assumptions; outputs include outlet temperature, pressure, energy and economic indicators over time. Geographic coverage is a user-specified project, with examples aimed at deep US resources. BSD-2-Clause source, local-run instructions and an API description are public. The README says the latest hosted application moved to OpenEI; that site returned HTTP 429 during this review, so its current availability was not verified. A limitation is that database interpolation is bounded by its training parameter range, and local geology needs validation. GeoCLUSTER can compare geothermal electricity or heat options. The related catalogue GEOPHIRES simulator is a separate geothermal tool. No HDF5 database, package or installer was downloaded.
name: GeoCLUSTER geothermal techno-economic simulator
